provenance.notes: R6-03.REING1 (player row P-9): the MANTA's signature bomb in eight frames — swirl frames 1-7 and the collapse burst frame 8, the sidecar's announced reading order, each cropped to its measured subject box plus a 6-px key border (the pad zone carries only this cell's own dim glow, 60 px clear of every neighbour box). Numeric probes: consecutive-frame keyed-pixel XOR 10.8-39.3% (the rotation and the burst are present, not duplicates), each swirl centre pure key-black — the hole itself — so the black key keeps it empty; the sheet corners measure #000000 exactly. Additive alpha on a black key, no outline pass.
